title: Farm Real Estate Loans Rate Bulletin — Seasoning Addition to the Homesite Release Premium
content:
The age of the loan raises the homesite's release premium percentage on a farmstead split of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage. This seasoning addition follows how long ago the loan closed: less than 48 months adds 5.0 points; 48 months up to 120 months adds 2.5 points; longer adds none.

**What the records show.** The loan's closing date, from which whole months are counted to the day of the release.

| Months since the loan closed | Addition to the release premium percentage |
|---|---|
| fewer than 48 | 5.0 points |
| 48 through 120 | 2.5 points |
| more than 120 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loans)

| Months since closing | Addition |
|---|---|
| 47 | 5.0 points |
| 48 | 2.5 points |
| 120 | 2.5 points |
| 121 | none |
